definition.def: If you refer to a couple of people or things, you mean two or approximately two of them, although the exact number is not important or you are not sure of it.
examples: Across the street from me there are a couple of police officers standing guard. [+ of]
I think the trouble will clear up in a couple of days. [+ of]
...a small town a couple of hundred miles from New York City. [+ of]

definition.def: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship.
examples: ...after burglars ransacked an elderly couple's home.
...an isolated spot popular with courting couples.

definition.def: A couple is two people that you see together on a particular occasion or that have some association.
examples: ...as the four couples began the opening dance.

definition.def: If you say that one thing produces a particular effect when it is coupled with another, you mean that the two things combine to produce that effect.
examples: ...a problem that is coupled with lower demand for the machines themselves. [be VERB-ed + with]
Over-use of those drugs, coupled with poor diet, leads to physical degeneration. [VERB-ed]
...memories or past failures, coupled with a feeling of guilt. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: If one piece of equipment is coupled to another, it is joined to it so that the two pieces of equipment work together.
examples: Its engine is coupled to a semiautomatic gearbox. [be VERB-ed + to]
The various systems are coupled together in complex arrays. [be V-ed + together]
